name: Deploy Nightly
description: Deploy an asset to a GitHub release with date and commit hash and delete old assets.

asset_name.description: Name of the file to upload with a $$ placeholder to insert date and hash into

asset_content_type.description: Content type of the uploaded file

max_releases.description: Maximum number of historical releases with the given asset_name to keep

ignore_hash.description: If a release asset exists associated with the current commit, upload anyway?

repo.description: Optionally specify the repository ("OwnerName/RepoName") where the release is located. Defaults to current repository

sha.description: Optionally specify the commit SHA for release filename. Defaults to SHA that triggered the workflow. Only the first 6 characters are used
